_note: GENERATED by refs/shot-bands.py from refs/face-size.json. Face height as a fraction of frame height, measured at 270x480 with a Haar detector. Bands are the terciles of the POOLED per-frame distribution across all references — the sizes the corpus actually shoots. Do not quote a single global target; see rule V.

wide.note: face small in frame: context, environment, an index or thumbnail card, a subject among other things

medium.note: head and shoulders with air above and below — the corpus default, and what both supplied references hold for most of their runtime

close.note: a feature fills the frame: use when the beat is about a detail that cannot be read at medium

variation.note: p90/p10 of face height within one reel. This is the axis that separates the references from our reels: they travel ~2.1x, we sat at 1.35x with everything else green. 1.8 is set below the corpus median so it is a floor, not a target to hit exactly.
